args.analysis: String#[] on a heap string returns a shared substring with MRB_STR_SHARED, refcnt==1, and ptr==shared->ptr when beg==0. Appending calls mrb_str_modify_keep_ascii, which frees the shared struct in the refcnt==1/ptr==shared->ptr path without clearing MRB_STR_SHARED. At GC/mrb_close, mrb_gc_free_str sees SHARED and calls str_decref on the freed shared struct.
